name: Tales for the Long Nights
detailed_description:
Tales for the Long Nights is a tactical roguelike adventure where survival is never a given. It feels like the world is actively conspiring against you, and to its credit, it’s doing a spectacular job. As a traveling merchant, recruit a team of mercenaries, fight off the many things that want you dead and try to turn a profit before something eats your team and you have to start again.

Every great adventure starts with a questionable hiring decision. And here you are, recruiting a band of mercenaries with wildly different skill levels, personal grudges, and at least one active bounty. Will your party emerge victorious, or will their heroic deeds be reduced to the long sigh and shaking head of a (not-so-genuinely) grieving relative?

Goblins. Ogres. A dragon that’s about five minutes away from turning you into a cautionary tale for other travellers... It might feel like the world is actively conspiring against you, but to be fair, it's always like this. Engage in brutal, tactical battles where every ability matters, and victory hinges on strategy, luck, and possibly a bit more luck.

Take the Road Less Paved (Even Though Wagons Do Notoriously Badly Off-Road)

Travel across a vast, unruly world, where no two journeys are the same. Chart a path through deep forests, mountain passes, and places that really should have more warning signs. Every route you choose is a gamble.

As you fumble your way through an increasingly hostile world, you’ll unlock powerful abilities and team synergies that just might prolong your inevitable doom. Experiment, adapt, and enjoy the fleeting moments of feeling like an unstoppable force - before the game not so gently reminds you that hubris is a dangerous thing.

The road ahead is anything but predictable. Just when you think you have a handle on things, the world throws a curveball. Fortune, disaster, and outright absurdity lurk in equal measure, ensuring no two journeys ever unfold the same way. Some choices will lead to unexpected rewards, others to immediate and highly educational regrets. Either way, you'll have a story to tell - assuming you survive long enough to tell it.

In a world where death is always one bad decision away, there’s one thing you can count on—you will amass an ungodly amount of stuff. From enchanted weapons to slightly moldy cheese, everything has a use… even if that use is “getting sold to the next merchant with low standards”. Gather rare materials, craft legendary gear, and cobble together the tools of your next victory.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS *: Windows 7 SP1 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-6400 (4×3.2 GHz) or AMD Ryzen 3 1200 (4×3.1 GHz)
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 960 (4 GB) or AMD Radeon RX 560 (4 GB)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX-compatible sound card
  • VR Support: Not required
